title: Unofficial Homeowners: Back Home in Virginia Beach (2007–2008)
description: Returning to the family brick ranch on Arvin Road in Kempsville after walking out of Fishersville, twins Katie and Nate Prairie establish their day-to-day lives together—sleeping skin to skin in their bedroom closet while leaving the queen bed untouched, crossing crosswalk-free Indian River Road and Military Highway for groceries at Market Square, taking CVTA Route 12 to the Buckner Boulevard DMV to trade their vertical Under-21 cards for horizontal 21+ Virginia State ID cards, getting yearly passes at the 1977 Fairlawn Recreation Center, forming Prairie Twin Interactive, LLC after a near-miss with their mother Brenda at dying Glenrock Mall, touring the White House, the U.S. Capitol Rotunda, and the U.S. Senate Gallery on their 22nd birthday courtesy of Senator James West, discovering the 5:30 PM City Council bus curfew that sparks Katie's decision to run for office, applying for their first U.S. Passports at the Post Office, and launching their own paid web studio after polite corporate job rejections.
